input: Reserve a campsite for the long weekend getaway

gold.taskTitle: Reserve a Campsite for the Long Weekend
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to book a campsite for an upcoming long weekend trip.

questions.title: Which long weekend are you targeting for this trip?
questions.description: Identify the specific long weekend dates the user has in mind.

questions.title: How many people will be joining the camping trip?
questions.description: Determine the group size to find a suitable campsite.

questions.title: What region or park do you want to camp in?
questions.description: Narrow down the geographic location or specific park the user prefers.

questions.title: Will you be tent camping, using an RV, or a cabin?
questions.description: Clarify the type of accommodation needed at the campsite.

questions.title: Do you need hookups like electricity or water at the site?
questions.description: Determine if the user needs utility hookups or is fine with primitive camping.

questions.title: What is your budget per night for the campsite?
questions.description: Understand the user's spending limit to filter appropriate options.

questions.title: Do you have a specific booking platform or membership already?
questions.description: Find out if the user has access to ReserveAmerica, Recreation.gov, KOA, or similar services.
